Subject: Interested in Redwood — would love a quick demo

Hi team,

I signed up for Redwood last week while evaluating embedding providers for our recommendation engine. We'd like to see a short demo to understand latency/cost tradeoffs and how dedicated pools would map to our peak traffic.

High-level: FastFruit is a grocery marketplace (US-only for now). Main goals: faster product search, similar-item recommendations, and smarter cart suggestions during peak hours.

Can someone help me book a 30–45 minute walkthrough this week? PST mornings are best for us.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of ML, FastFruit
samir@fastfruit.co

Attachments: sample-traffic.csv (referenced below)

Hi Samir — congrats on the signup and thanks for the note. I can take this and schedule a short session with our Solutions Engineer. A few quick questions so we make the demo actionable: 

- Primary use case: search latency-sensitive ranking vs. batch embeddings for recommendations? (both are fine, helps us pick model/quantization)
- Peak QPS and typical request size (tokens per request or average embedding batch size).
- Are you evaluating hosted API first or looking at Dedicated/Private from the start?
- Timeline: pilot vs. production target (quarter/month) — helps prioritize feature demo (SLOs, autoscaling).
- Any compliance constraints (data residency, SOC2 evidence) we should prep for?

If you prefer, grab any of these slots: https://cal.example.com/irene/redwood-demo (PST morning blocks). I can also invite Ben Carter (solutions) if you want deeper throughput discussion.

Attached: initial-intake-form.pdf (very short; optional).

Thanks —
Priyom
SDR, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai
From: Samir Patel <samir@fastfruit.co>

Cc: Aisha Malik <a.malik@fastfruit.co>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood — would love a quick demo

Hi Priyom — thanks for the fast reply. Answers below inline.

> Primary use case: search latency-sensitive ranking vs. batch embeddings for recommendations?
We use both. Search (low latency) is priority for checkout conversion; recommendations run as nightly and hourly batches.

> Peak QPS and typical request size
Peak search: ~600 requests/s (morning rush 8–11am PST) — average search request ~120 tokens. Embeddings: ~30k items/day processed in batches (we'd like options for offline vs. on-demand embedding refresh).

> Hosted vs Dedicated
We'd like to evaluate hosted first but need a path to Dedicated if cost or latency requires it.

> Timeline: pilot vs production
Pilot goal: start in mid-August (Q3); production target: late Q4.

> Compliance constraints
SOC2 is required for vendor review; currently we store only item-level metadata (no PII).

I attached a small sample traffic CSV for your reference (sample-traffic.csv).

For the demo slots, PST mornings work. Could you propose 3 options next week? Ideally please include a slot where your SE (Ben) can join to discuss concurrency and autoscaling.

Appreciate it —
Samir
